parameters.command: =python3 -c 'import json, math; from pathlib import Path; d=float("{{ Number($json.ue_distance_2d_m) }}"); p=float("{{ Number($json.ue_tx_power_dbm) }}"); r=float("{{ Number($json.offered_load_mbps) }}"); s=float("{{ Number($json.rng_seed) }}"); n=float("{{ Number($json.rng_run) }}"); idx=float("{{ Number($json.experiment_index) }}"); eid="{{ Number($execution.id) }}"; assert eid.isdigit(), "Invalid execution ID"; assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (d,p,r,s,n,idx)), "Non-finite input"; assert idx.is_integer() and 1<=idx<=1000000, "Invalid experiment index"; assert d>0 and r>0, "Distance and load must be positive"; assert s.is_integer() and 1<=s<4294967087, "Invalid seed"; assert n.is_integer() and 1<=n<=9007199254740991, "Invalid run"; bps=round(r*1000000); assert bps>0, "Load too small"; c=json.loads(Path("scratch/default/dag.json").read_text()); c["ue"][0]["placement"]["distance_2d_m"]=d; c["ue"][0]["characteristics"]["phy"]["tx_power"]=p; c["connections"][0]["characteristics"]["application"]["dataRate"]=str(bps)+"bps"; c["simulation"]["seed"]=int(s); c["simulation"]["run"]=int(n); folder=Path("experiments")/("execution_"+eid)/("experiment_"+str(int(idx))); folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False); target=folder/"config.json"; target.write_text(json.dumps(c,indent=2)); print(json.dumps({"experiment_index":int(idx),"config_path":str(target),"results_path":str(folder/"results.json"),"experiment_dir":str(folder.resolve()),"ue_distance_2d_m":d,"ue_tx_power_dbm":p,"offered_load_bps":bps,"rng_seed":int(s),"rng_run":int(n)}))'

parameters.command: =python3 -c 'import csv, io, json; from pathlib import Path; eid="{{ Number($execution.id) }}"; assert eid.isdigit(), "Invalid execution ID"; root=Path("experiments")/("execution_"+eid); groups=[sorted((root/("experiment_"+str(i))).glob("*.csv")) for i in (1,2,3)]; assert all(len(g)==1 for g in groups), "Expected exactly one CSV per experiment"; batches=[list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(g[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))) for g in groups]; assert all(len(b)==1 for b in batches), "Expected one data row per experiment"; rows=[b[0] for b in batches]; fields=list(rows[0]); assert all(list(row)==fields for row in rows), "CSV columns differ"; assert all(row["n8n_execution_id"]==eid for row in rows), "Execution ID mismatch"; assert [row["experiment_id"] for row in rows]==["distance_50m","distance_100m","distance_150m"], "Unexpected experiment IDs"; assert [float(row["ue_distance_2d_m"]) for row in rows]==[50,100,150], "Unexpected distances"; target=root/"batch_dataset.csv"; f=target.open("x",newline="",encoding="utf-8"); writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields); writer.writeheader(); writer.writerows(rows); f.close(); print(json.dumps({"dataset_path":str(target.resolve()),"rows":len(rows),"experiments":[row["experiment_id"] for row in rows]}))'
